title: The Ultimate F1 Helicopter Tour Experience
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: You will spend approximately 15 minutes before, and a few minutes after the tour, for a safety brief and debrief
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Take your Formula 1 experience to the next level with our Circuit of the Americas Helicopter Tour, offering an unparalleled aerial view of COTA, home of the United States Grand Prix. 

This 36-mile tour is a must-do for motorsports enthusiasts, racing fans, and thrill-seekers looking to witness one of the world’s most iconic race tracks from the sky.

Secure your VIP flight today!
